semiconductor_relevance: High — Gemmy-Tek provides specialized equipment and solutions for semiconductor packaging and inspection processes.
summary: Gemmy-Tek Technology Co., Ltd. is a process solution provider specializing in equipment for semiconductor packaging and inspection. Founded in 2002, the company offers a range of professional equipment and services, including die inspection, package inspection, and wire bonding inspection, aimed at optimizing production processes for clients.

regional_presence.Taiwan: Gemmy-Tek's headquarters are located in Taoyuan, Taiwan, with service locations in Kaohsiung.
regional_presence.China: The company has service locations in Suzhou and Dongguan, China, to support its operations.
